description: This is a test class for the EmailQueueDao, within the OrangeHRM project. It contains setup and multiple test methods to validate email queue operations such as retrieving, saving, deleting, and listing pending emails.

classes.name: EmailQueueDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmailQueueDao methods related to email queue management in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmailQueueDao instance, sets fixture path, populates test data, and creates the application kernel.

methods.name: testGetEmail
methods.description: Tests retrieving an email by ID from the email queue.

methods.name: testSaveEmail
methods.description: Tests saving a new email into the queue and verifies the stored properties.

methods.name: testRemoveFromQueue
methods.description: Tests removing emails from the queue by their IDs.

methods.name: testGetAllPendingMailIds
methods.description: Tests retrieving all IDs of emails pending in the queue.
